name: crp-memory-direct
description: Authenticated, read-only CRP recall using the existing server, with evidence and character boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Direct connection to the existing authenticated CRP server. Search and fetch within the host-bound character, reality and story time. Preserves source evidence and uncertainty; contains no private archive or API keys.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use CRP Memory Direct to search my authorized memories and verify the returned source evidence.
